raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 144 txn_id values that appear as exact replicas (identical in every column, including batch_id and ingest_ts), and the txn_id range is contiguous, so the extra rows are redelivery copies rather than distinct transactions. silver_transactions does not deduplicate, so these copies carry into silver and then into every gold table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT DISTINCT ON (txn_id) CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' ORDER BY txn_id;"}}
